role: startup co-founder (positioning, objections, pricing, conversion path, truthfulness)
verdict: Positioning is clear in five seconds, pricing is exact and honest at both billing periods, the preview status is disclosed at every signup step, and the working Try box carries the proof that testimonials normally would. It falls just short of 9.5 because that proof weakens on a genuinely flabby line: the on-device check leaves obvious filler in the result and the page gives no in-context bridge to what the app's Sharpen does.
to_95: In the Try box and final-input result, when the engine reports leftovers ('N left to you') or returns 'Nothing to cut', add one quiet line under the result: 'This is the quick on-device check. In the app, Sharpen goes further. Still free.' so a weak demo result reads as a floor, not the product's ceiling.

Make the Sharpen-versus-rewrite distinction visible on the pricing cards themselves (one short clause on the Free card's rewrite row, e.g. 'A rewrite is three new takes; Sharpen never uses one') instead of only in the footnote under the cards.
Fix the truncated quote in the 'Why it hits' line for announcement leads ('It now opens on "We raised a $4M seed led"'): end the quoted span on a phrase boundary.

issues.where: #sharpen Try box result (and final CTA input result), any width
issues.problem: With no social proof allowed, the live demo is the page's only evidence. On a wordy pasted line ('In my humble opinion I really do believe that it is not very important to post every single day') the result is 'I really do believe it is not very important to post every single day.' with a 'Keep it. Start free' button. The result is honest ('1 left to you') but still flabby, and nothing next to it says this is the on-device quick check or that the app's Sharpen does more; that fact lives only inside one closed FAQ answer. A sceptical visitor concludes this is the whole product.
issues.fix: When r.marks has leftovers or state is 'clean', render one muted line beneath the result card: 'Quick on-device check. In the app, Sharpen goes further. Still free.' Keep it out of the default sample runs so strong results stay uncluttered.

issues.problem: Two units are in play: Sharpen (free, unmetered) and rewrites (20 / 250 / 500, with voice learning costing 5 once, reply drafts ten-per-one, reply-ping drafts free). The definition of a rewrite sits only in the small footnote under all three cards, so the Free card's '20 rewrites' can be read as a cap on the headline feature.
issues.fix: On the Free card change the row to '20 rewrites a month: three new takes each. Sharpen never uses one.' and drop the first footnote sentence.

issues.where: Free card, 'Past the daily limit, Sharpen runs on your device. Still free.'
issues.problem: The headline says 'Sharpening is free. Forever.' and the card mentions a daily limit without a number, which invites the 'what's the catch' question on the exact claim the section leads with.
issues.fix: State the figure the app enforces ('Past N a day, Sharpen runs on your device') or, if it is not fixed yet, say 'Past a fair-use daily limit'.

issues.where: Final input and Try box, announcement lines
issues.problem: For 'Excited to announce we raised a $4M seed led by a16z!' the explanation reads: It now opens on "We raised a $4M seed led", cutting the quote mid-phrase.
issues.fix: Trim the quoted opening at a phrase boundary (before a trailing verb/preposition), e.g. "We raised a $4M seed".

issues.where: Try box results for sentence-case lines
issues.problem: The engine appends a full stop the writer did not type ('...until I started freelancing.') and contracts 'we are' to 'we're' while the page promises 'It still sounds like you' and only credits the cuts.
issues.fix: Leave terminal punctuation and contractions as written unless the move is named in the 'Cut ...' summary line.

issues.where: Desktop Free card versus the 'Say it at 11 PM' bento
issues.problem: Voice dictation and best-time are sold as a full bento section but their plan (Free) is only visible after opening 'See everything included', so a visitor cannot tell if the section they just liked is paid.
issues.fix: Swap 'Reply drafts when you ask' out of the Free card's visible five for 'Say it out loud, and your best time to post'.
